overview_description.description:
Hotglue enables developers to offer native, user-facing SaaS integrations to customers in minutes without sacrificing control over the data.

By embedding Hotglue into web apps, customers can connect their 3rd party SaaS apps without leaving their application, and can confidently ingest any data needed scalably. Plus, Hotglue's open-source library of connectors enables developers to offer more integrations to users without using development resources.

product.name: hotglue Embedded iPaaS Platform
product.description: A platform that enables developers to embed user-facing SaaS integrations, allowing products to receive and transform customer data via configurable connectors and workflows.

product.name: hotglue Connector Builder
product.description: A tool to create custom data connectors without coding, supporting OAuth authentication and parent/child data streams.

product.name: hotglue Bi-Directional Flows
product.description: A feature that allows data to be read from and written to the same connector within a single integration flow.

product.name: hotglue Real-Time Write API
product.description: An API feature that allows instant writing of data to connectors with immediate validation and feedback.

product.name: hotglue Streaming Read Jobs
product.description: A feature that streams data directly from a source connector to a target, bypassing transformation steps for faster data syncs.
